payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_batch.py::test_a_follow_up_its_budget_cannot_cover_is_passed_over_and_the_next_one_runs stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/batch.py. The claim was "A follow-up whose `budget_usd` exceeds what is left is passed over the same way, named on the same line, and the next follow-up that fits runs on the order's top layer. The follow-up passed over is named in the `follow-ups unrun` line, and the batch ends `BUDGET`. It is named once, though the follow-up pass offers it again after the next follow-up's task.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
